prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down RPG character animation spritesheet.
Create one transparent PNG sheet, a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid with 16 separate poses of the SAME hooded child Nhinh from the supplied references. Reference images are identity/style only; recreate the child faithfully: cream hood and short cloak, short dark brown hair, red scarf, dark trousers, brown boots, small golden lantern held in the character's right hand. Crisp pixel art with hard square pixels, dark outline, compact silhouette, limited palette. No text, no labels, no border, no floor, no shadow ellipse, no decorative background.
ALL 16 poses face DOWN toward viewer in the same top-down camera perspective. Lock character scale, anatomy, hood size, outfit details and physical right-hand lantern ownership. Each of 16 cells occupies exactly one quarter of width/height; center each pose in its cell with ample transparent margin, consistent foot baseline and same scale. Never overlap cells. Each pose should be designed to remain readable when reduced to a 36 by 42 pixel frame (character ~29px wide and 36px tall).
Reading cells left-to-right top-to-bottom:
1 idle calm, feet planted, unlit lantern lowered.
2 walk left-foot forward, lantern lowered unlit.
3 walk passing feet, lantern lowered unlit.
4 walk right-foot forward, lantern lowered unlit.
5 run long left stride, torso leaning, scarf trailing.
6 run airborne passing pose, leaning and scarf trailing.
7 run long right stride, torso leaning, scarf trailing.
8 switch lantern ON: lift unlit lantern and reach toward its switch.
9 switch lantern ON: thumb engages switch, first small warm light.
10 switch lantern ON: settle with bright golden lit lantern lowered.
11 switch lantern OFF: lift bright lit lantern, free hand approaching switch.
12 switch lantern OFF: thumb engages switch, warm light shrinking.
13 switch lantern OFF: settle with unlit lantern lowered.
14 PULSE: raise lit lantern high, tense anticipation.
15 PULSE: lantern held high, concentrated bright mint-gold burst confined around lantern and body.
16 PULSE: lower lantern halfway, fading few gold sparkles.
Action gestures must be visibly different; exact same character repeated. Transparent RGBA background. Return only the spritesheet, no captions.
